u09-rem-mid.resolution: I checked each flag against the Greek and found no meaning error. LXX Ps 139 counts the title as verse 1 (v. 2 Ἐξελοῦ με = English 140:1), so LXX 139:9 = English 140:8 and 139:11 = English 140:10, as now given. LXX and Hebrew verse numbers coincide here; English is one lower. 'And they will fall a fall—not the kind the righteous fall …' renders fragment 290's Καὶ πεσοῦνται πτῶσιν, οὐχ οἵαν οἱ δίκαιοι πίπτοντες καὶ ἀνιστάμενοι ἀλλὰ τὴν ἀνίατον …, which is in the Greek; the 'invented' flag looked only at the following clause. οὐδὲ βραχεῖς ᾠήθην … εἶναι τοὺς δικαίους is 'I did not think the righteous few'. 'The whole earth is filled with the knowledge of the Lord' is quoted in the Greek and given no false reference. The rest is idiom.
